results.description:
Beijing’s security concerns cloud Nepal’s push to reopen Tatopani

Flood damage to Rasuwagadhi and the high cost of Korala leave the Sindhupalchok crossing vital to Nepal’s trade with China, but Beijing remains reluctant to reopen it over concerns about Tibet.
